app.name: Anime AI Companion
avatar.dragHint: Drag to move · double-click to chat
chat.title: Chat
chat.placeholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.error.invalid: The message is empty or too long.
chat.error.internal: Something went wrong. Please try again.
chat.error.busy: Please wait for the current answer to finish, or stop it.
chat.error.noModel: No model is selected yet. Open model settings to choose one.
chat.error.connection: Cannot reach Ollama. Check that it is running, then try again.
chat.error.timeout: The model took too long to respond. Try again, use a smaller model or raise the timeout.
chat.error.modelNotFound: This model is not downloaded. Run: ollama pull {model}
chat.error.empty: The model returned an empty answer. Please try again.
chat.error.responseTooLong: The answer was too long and has been stopped.
chat.error.badResponse: Received an unexpected response from the model server.
chat.saveFailed: The answer could not be saved to disk.
settings.title: Model settings
settings.unreachable: Cannot connect. Install Ollama from ollama.com, make sure it is running, and check the address.
settings.timeoutError: Ollama did not answer in time.
settings.badResponse: The server at this address did not respond like Ollama.
settings.modelMissing: “{model}” is not downloaded. Run: ollama pull {model}
settings.noModels: No models downloaded yet. Run in a terminal, for example: ollama pull llama3.2
settings.maxHistory: Past messages sent to the model
settings.persistHint: Stored unencrypted in the app's data folder. Turning this off deletes the saved conversation.
settings.invalidEndpoint: Only an http address on this computer is allowed, such as http://127.0.0.1:11434.
settings.invalidNumber: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
